title: Paper Note
description: Output of literature-ingest. A selected paper distilled into a typed, citable note. The Tier-S spine of the 0+3+1 research card: Stage-0 positioning (paper_type / read_purpose / relation_to_thesis / reading_objective / reading_status) + Pass-1 contract (paper_contract) + summary + atomic claims + methods/datasets/metrics, by reference. Deeper passes live in separate artifacts (claim_evidence_map / method_teardown / figure_reading / paper_appraisal / paper_relations / trend_card). Ingestion produces draft knowledge only — it never freezes.

vault_slug.description: Set ONLY by an ingest run given vault_root: the slug of an EXISTING 02-wiki/papers page whose title (normalized) or source ref matches this paper. A read-only cross-reference, not an assertion that this note IS that page. null / absent = no match found (or no vault scanned).

possible_duplicate.description: True when vault_slug was set — flags that this paper may already be in the vault so the director can dedup before promoting. Advisory only; ingestion still produces draft knowledge and never blocks.

paper_type.description: Stage-0 positioning: kind of paper; selects the downstream reading lens + reporting standard. null = not yet classified.

read_purpose.description: Stage-0 positioning: why this paper is being read (drives reading depth).

relation_to_thesis.description: Stage-0 positioning: A-core (deep/reproduce) | B-related (method+conclusions) | C-background (skim). Mirrors the DB page relevance dial.

reading_objective.description: Stage-0 positioning: one-line objective — what this read must establish for the thesis.

reading_status.description: Depth dial, mirrors the DB paper-page reading-status ladder; determines which deeper artifacts a full read produces.

paper_contract.description: Pass-1 5-C contract: the one-sentence claim plus Keshav's five C's.

contract_sentence.description: problem -> method -> vs prior -> evidence -> applicability conditions.
